messages:
Asha: Uploaded 'Deploy Slate' one-pager (1p) focusing on SLAs, secure deploy modes, and quick benchmark. Link: https://docs.google.com/d/deploy-slate
Tom: Quick pass looks clean. Two asks: add a compact stat card (p95 + unit cost delta) and a one-line rollback/fallback sentence.
Riley: For inbound routing, I recommend auto-attach when form.checkbox('enterprise') or form.select('deployment') == 'on-prem'. Also flag "SLAs required" for SE follow-up.
Tom: Draft benchmark text: "p95 latency ≈ 130ms (typical gen); hosted est ≈ $0.016 / 1k tokens; reserved/dedicated can cut unit cost ≈ 33% at steady utilization." Short and usable on a graphic.
Asha: Nice. For messaging, CTA candidates: (A) "Download Deploy Slate: SLAs & secure deploy checklist" (gated) (B) "Request 30m SLA scoping call" (high-touch). I want A primary.
Riley: Inbound pseudo-rules (YAML-like):
```
routes:
  - when: form.checkbox('enterprise') or form.fields.contains('SLAs required')
    action: attach('Deploy-Slate.pdf')
    assign: enterprise-field
    priority: high
  - when: form.select('deployment') == 'on-prem' or form.notes.contains('air-gapped')
    action: assign(solutions-engineering); notify(security@redwood.com)
  - otherwise:
    action: assign(growth-sdr)
```
Riley: Also add SDR note template: "Lead requested SLAs; attach Deploy Slate; propose 30m scoping call with SEs."
Tom: Webinar subject options for promotion A/B test: 
- "Deploying LLMs with enterprise SLAs and secure networking"
- "Operational LLM serving: SLAs, VPCs, and graceful fallbacks"
Asha: Can someone craft a 25s talking point to read on stage and add a 1-line social post? If yes, I will schedule the announcement.
Tom: 25s talking point: "Teams are balancing latency, cost and compliance. With a unified serving runtime you can set SLAs, choose VPC or on-prem networking, and rely on automatic fallbacks and rollouts to keep your product available during upgrades."
Asha: Social microcopy: "New one-pager: Deploy Slate  SLAs, secure deployment modes, and a quick cost/latency snapshot. Download -> [link]"
SalesFlowBot: Event created: 'Deploy Slate final review' Thu 11:00 AM. Invited: Asha, Tom, Riley.
Asha: Action items: Tom -> add benchmark & 25s line into doc; Riley -> push routing to playbook + SDR template; Asha -> pick CTA, finalize PDF, schedule social and webinar promo. Target: EOD Fri. 
Tom: I'll update the doc by noon tomorrow.
Riley: Routing pushed to playbook, SDR note created. ETA 3pm tomorrow.
Asha: Thanks team :rocket:
